profile.subtitleJa: ヨシャファトの子で、父の後を継いでユダの王となった人物です。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下21:1は、ヨシャファトの死後にその子ヨラムが王位を継いだと記します。
profile.identityNoteJa: イスラエルの王ヨラムとは別人です。ここではヨシャファトの子で、ユダを治めた王を指します。

facts.textJa: ヨラムは長子だったため、父から王国を受け継いだと記されています。
王国を固めた後、本文は兄弟たちとイスラエルの高官たちを殺したと記します。
32歳で王となり、エルサレムで8年間治めたと記されています。
本文は、ヨラムが夜にエドム人の包囲を破って攻撃したと記します。
ペリシテ人とクシュ人の近くに住むアラビア人が彼に敵対するようになったと記されます。
アハズヤはヨラムの子で、ユダの王として治めたと記されます。
ヨシャファテアはヨラム王の娘であり、祭司エホヤダの妻、アハズヤの姉妹と記されます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Their father gave them great gifts of silver, of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Now when Jehoram had risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and also some of the princes of Israel.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: Then Jehoram went there with his captains and all his chariots with him. He rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: The LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians;

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place, because the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the oldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryWitnesses.text: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of King Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.
